scripts.build:android: yarn workspace @ajitpatel28/react-native-truecaller build:plugin && expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a
scripts.build:ios: yarn workspace @ajitpatel28/react-native-truecaller build:plugin && expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/ReactNativeTruecallerExample.xcworkspace -scheme ReactNativeTruecallerExample -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
